item.text: Dear [Organizer’s Name], I really enjoyed the first rehearsal and appreciated the warm welcome from everyone. Unfortunately, I need to miss the next two rehearsals because of prior commitments. I’m sorry to be away so soon after joining, but I’m keen to continue with the choir. Would it be practical for me to return after those sessions, or would I have missed too much to catch up comfortably? Thank you for your advice. Best wishes, [Your Name]
